entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-27
entry.content:
Issues

Closed

  • On Windows, FileVersionInfo OriginalFilename of a self-contained application should reflect the published file name #29055
  • Cannot run Microsoft.Web.LibraryManager.Cli tool with .NET 6/7 SDK's #24648
  • `dotnet build` treats dependencies differently when targeting .sln vs .csproj #25973

Updated

  • dotnet-watch BrowserTests.BrowserDiagnostics hangs on Windows Helix (test host blame-hang timeout) #57235
  • [Known Build Error] ASP.NET Core formatter fixture bootstrap fails on native sources and reference pack #57034
  • [Known Build Error] Formatter MSBuild fixture restore fails with BuildXL feed authorization error #57033
  • [Known Build Error] Satellite-assembly localized stdout encoding mismatch #57032
  • [aw] Detection Runs #56812
  • Template Engine SSL Connection Issue #51574
  • Workload Feature Band Test Sometimes Fails #45314
  • Failure on Helix tests - Tests timing out #40074
  • dotnet-watch tests failing #40006
  • dotnet test cannot launch test executables from long paths on Windows #57368
  • CA2026 autofix generating non-compiling code #57198
  • CA1508 runs for an hour or more on a method with recursive local functions called from nested loops #57327
  • CA2241 false-positive diagnostic when using Composite [StringSyntax] on an extension method overload with a IFormatProvider parameter. #57258
  • CA1515: account for MSTest test classes that need to remain public #57223
  • CA2012 false positive when a ValueTask-returning query expression is returned or awaited #57101
  • CA2007 does not report `await foreach` over `WithCancellation(...)` without `ConfigureAwait` #57090
  • CA2000 false positive when a disposable is passed to a primary constructor and stored #56639
  • Expand optimized publish support beyond Native AOT in .NET 12 #55911
  • `PublishContainer` fails for `net481`: `'4.8.1.0' is not a valid version string` in `ComputeDotnetBaseImageAndTag` #57367

PullRequests

Created

  • Add freebsd-ppc64le to the .NET 11 apphost RIDs #57381
  • Strengthen workload package signature verification #57380
  • Use pigz when available in TarGzFileCreateFromDirectory #57379
  • [release/10.0.4xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #57378
  • Fix linked static web assets causing "More than one compatible asset found for" build error #57377
  • Prevent PublishContainer telemetry failures for four-part framework versions #57376

Merged

  • [dotnet test] Coordinate MTP invocation-lifetime handlers across test modules #57357

Updated

  • Use a build-owned static asset for browser tools activation #56386
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #57192
